summary: FourCC-to-format-identifier decoder. Dispatches on the incoming 32-bit value a1: four specific FourCC constants (909200416, 909200449, 909201952, 909201985) map to small format identifiers 50, 51, 20 and 21 respectively; any other value is returned unchanged. Used during surface-format negotiation by DirectXSurfaceFormatNegotiation (0x00502A15).

operations.description: Dispatch switch on a1; only the four listed constant cases take the mapping path, everything else falls to the identity default.
Default path returns the original value a1 unchanged when it matches no mapped FourCC; the function is invoked from DirectXSurfaceFormatNegotiation (0x00502A15).
